Network.SIM: Dual eSIM (US), Dual nano-SIM (Hong Kong, Macau and mainland China), nano-SIM and eSIM (elsewhere)

Body.Other: Emergency SOS, Messages and Find My via satellite, FaceTime Audio or Video at 1080p over Wi-Fi and 5G, Voice over 5G Standalone (if supported by the carrier)

Display.Display: Super Retina XDR OLED 16: 6.1 in resolution (~460 ppi density), 16 Plus: 6.7 in resolution (~460 ppi density)

Battery.Battery: 16: 13.84 Wh (3561 mAh) Lithium-ion battery, Li-ion @ 3.89 V, 16 Plus: 18.11 Wh (4674 mAh) Li-ion @ 3.88 V
Battery.Charging: MagSafe (wireless charger), MagSafe and Qi 2 wireless, USB-C fast-charge

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be) tri-band, Bluetooth 5.3 (A2DP, LE) , Ultra-wideband (UWB) , Thread, NFC (reader mode, Express Cards), USB-C: USB 2.0 480 Mbit/s, GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, BeiDou
